summary: Iteration 13: tested AI scene descriptions (backend + Studio UI) and the mobile/landscape/desktop thumbnail overlay. Backend: test_ai_describe.py passed 6/6 using a real interior photo. Uploading a scene fills an empty description in the background in under 10s with 38 words of Indonesian in one paragraph and sets description_ai=true. POST /scenes/{sid}/describe returns 200 for staff, 403 for client, 401 without a token and 404 for an unknown id, and it does not save. A PATCH description persists. Studio UI: the button label changes correctly ('Tulis ulang dengan AI' / 'Buat dengan AI' / 'Menulis…' and disabled while busy), the field fills, the 'Klik Simpan' toast appears, and the saved text survives a reload. Mobile 390x844 and 375x667: no bottom thumb-rail; the overlay is shown on load and hides after 3.5s; the handle shows the overlay again; tapping the stage toggles it; othumb-N navigates; a scene change re-shows it; prev/next do not toggle it (they re-show it only because the scene changes); the topline play button does not toggle it. A swipe on the overlay does not navigate, while a swipe on the stage does. There is no page scroll; at 375x667 the story panel scrolls inside itself. Landscape 844x390: the overlay works and auto-hides. Desktop 1920x800: the bottom thumb-rail is visible, with no overlay or handle. The sample project (Revisi 05, AI descriptions) was only read. 3 LLM calls in total plus 2 auto-describes.

minor.issue: description_ai stays true after a person edits and saves the description, so the Studio note 'Deskripsi awal dibuat otomatis oleh AI' keeps showing on text the designer wrote. Reproduced with test_05 (prints True) and in the UI (note still visible after save and reload). Fix: set description_ai=false when description is in the PATCH and differs from the stored value. Alternatively keep it true only when the PATCH saves exactly the AI text.
No reference to the task is kept, so it could be garbage-collected mid-run (Python docs warning). Keep the tasks in a module-level set.

ui_bugs.component: Studio ScenePanel after uploading a new render
ui_bugs.issue: The editor never re-fetches the draft, so the AI default description is filled in the DB ~5-10s after upload but the panel still shows an empty description until a full reload. Worse, saving the title or area in that window sends description:'' from the stale form, which overwrites the AI text in the DB (the conditional update in auto_describe only stops the AI from overwriting; nothing stops the user from overwriting it). Found by code review: there is no polling or reload anywhere; not reproduced via a UI upload. Fix: poll the draft or scene a few times after upload until description is set or description_ai is true. Also send only changed fields in the PATCH, or skip description when it is unchanged and empty.

While the overlay rail is shown (first 3.5s after each scene change), the full-width wrap (z-30) covers landscape-denah-btn and landscape-story-overlay. elementFromPoint at the Denah button center returns thumb-rail-overlay, so Denah cannot be tapped and the story caption shows through the thumbs. Fix: hide the story overlay and Denah button while railShown, or lift them above the rail, or limit the rail width in landscape.

issues: The mini-plan sits below the fold inside the internally scrolling story panel (scrollHeight 456 vs clientHeight 295). This is acceptable, but the user only sees the 'LANTAI 1 / PERBESAR' header.
The hotspot label 'KE DAPUR' is clipped at the right edge and overlaps next-scene-btn.

The onScroll on thumb-rail-overlay-wrap never fires because the scroll happens on the inner ThumbRail div and React onScroll does not bubble. Only touchstart resets the timer, so a long drag of more than 3.5s can hide the rail (pointer-events-none) mid-scroll. Move onScroll to the ThumbRail element or use onScrollCapture.

action_items: Studio: after a scene upload, poll or reload the scene until the AI description arrives. Avoid sending a stale empty description in PATCH so it cannot wipe the AI default.
Backend PATCH /scenes/{sid}: reset description_ai=false when a person changes the description.
Landscape: stop the overlay rail covering the Denah button and the story caption (hide them while railShown, or change the z-order).
Move the rail's onScroll handler to the actual scrolling element (or use onScrollCapture) so scrolling keeps the overlay visible.
Keep references to the background auto_describe tasks.
critical_code_review_comments: ScenePanel saveInfo PATCHes the whole form, including the description, so stale state overwrites concurrent server-side changes.
RuangStage onScroll on the wrapper is dead code (scroll events do not bubble).
Existing test_inerre_api.py uploads solid-color JPEGs, and every upload now triggers an LLM call on a blank image. Consider an env flag to skip auto_describe in tests, or accept the cost.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all requested behaviours pass; 1 medium + 1 low issue)

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_AI Describe and TEST_AI UI (42b65daddae143cc9410764ca3c83f26), both removed. Sample project only read.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Clerk tickets are single-use and the session does not persist between browser_automation calls, so mint a new ticket per call (python ticket.py client). A storage_state copied into a new has_touch context works for touch tests. Swipe tests use synthetic TouchEvent dispatch. Run test_ai_describe.py with -p no:xdist -o addopts=""; it uses /app/frontend/public/hero-interior.jpg as the real photo. setup_ai_ui.py creates a TEST project and scene (and deletes with --delete PID).
